mapper.select:
select c.* , cr.name as course_name from customer c left join course cr on c.course_id = cr.id
and c.phone like concat('%',#{customerDto.getPhone()},'%')
and c.channel like concat('%',#{customerDto.getName()},'%')
and c.channel like concat('%',#{customerDto.getChannel()},'%')
and c.subject = #{customerDto.getSubject()}
order by c.update_time desc
